issues.description: Draft requires refusal of proof reused across feature/authorization but capture rule binds only candidate, argv and observations. Existing closed captures have no task/check/authorization context. One assessed candidate can contain multiple task records with identical commands, permitting one capture to substantiate both unless the contract specifies an enforceable context rule.
issues.evidence: acceptance_requirements[capture,candidate,compatibility]; closed published capture schema has only schema_version,argv,cwd,revision,candidate_sha256,environment,producer,executed,outcome,exit_code,stdout,stderr.

required_fixes: Specify enforceable capture-to-feature/authorization binding for raw and supported closed formats, with a same-candidate/multiple-task/same-command reuse regression; do not infer binding from untrusted QA feature_id alone.
Replace FIRST_PAIR_ACCEPTED_COMMIT with accepted first-pair pin and obtain final identical-digest reviews before approval.
advisory_minor: Known first-pair pin placeholder is expected at this pre-review and not yet final-gate ready.
Confirmed scope shell words equal typed argv, Python scope snippet compiles, and intended review artifact regex matches.
Material-membership, ownership mask restrictions, exact diagnostics, wrapper normalization, independent inventory and schema boundaries are now explicit.
